'''''Koh-Lanta: Panama''''' is the fourth season of ''[[Koh-Lanta]]''. It was broadcast on TF1 from July 2, 2004 to August 31, 2004.

[[Philippe Bordier]] defeated [[Linda Alario]] in a 7-0 [[jury]] vote to become the [[Sole Survivor]]. To date, this season has produced four returning players ([[Catherine Ehret-Mader]], Linda Alario, Philippe Bordier and [[Romuald Lafite]]) for future seasons.

==Production==
Like ''[[Koh-Lanta: Bocas del Toro|Bocas del Toro]]'', this season was held in Panama, but this time, filming took place in the Pearl Islands.

==Twists==
*'''[[Battle of the Sexes]]:''' For the first time, the castaways were divided into [[tribe]]s based on gender. [[Mogo]] consisted of only men, and [[Chapera (Koh-Lanta)|Chapera]] consisted of only women.
* '''One-Time [[Exile Island (twist)|Exile]]:''' Following the first [[Immunity Challenge]], one member of the losing tribe, as chosen by the winning tribe, would be exiled from camp for the next 48 hours.
* '''[[Tribe Switch]]:''' On Day 8, the scouts chosen on Day 1, alongside one person they each selected, were summoned by Denis Brogniart. He revealed that they would be switching tribes.
*'''Replacements:''' Due to the [[Evacuation|evacuations]] of [[Vidéli Dittmar]] and [[Odile Héritier]], [[Sophie Eeckhout]] and [[Linda Alario]] returned to the game to replace them respectively.
